explanation: The inner room of the temple where God was present, divided into the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place.
The act by which sin is covered or removed through a sacrifice to restore the relationship between humanity and God.
The physical evidence of life that was sacrificed, symbolizing the death penalty for sin in the Old Testament.
The concept of the earthly temple service as an imperfect copy or image of heavenly reality.
The true and eternal sanctuary where Jesus has now entered to represent humanity directly before God.
The act in which Jesus offered himself once for all, in contrast to the repeated sacrifices under the old covenant system.
A binding agreement or contract between God and people, here referring to the new covenant established on Jesus' blood.
